cases.ask: Any leave requests waiting for me?
Reject the oldest leave request waiting for me because we have a deployment that day
cases.reference: A rejection card with the reason already in it; nothing asked.

cases.ask: Reject the oldest leave request waiting for me
cases.reference: Asks why — a rejection is never sent without a reason.

cases.ask: Approve the oldest leave request waiting for me
Approve the leave request waiting for me that another project manager has already approved
cases.reference: An approval card for the request whose line says it is approved by one project manager and still waiting for the asker and a third. Does not say the leave will be approved: once confirmed, the approval is recorded and the leave still waits for the third project manager, who is named.
